{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Sunflora Lodge |characters=ペンションキマワリ |japanese=Pension Kimawari |image=Sunflora Lodge.png |imagesize=250px |region=Johto |epicode=EP187 |episode=Moving Pictures }} The '''Sunflora Lodge''' (Japanese: '''ペンションキマワリ''' ''Pension {{tt|Kimawari|Sunflora}}'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Johto]]. It appeared in ''[[EP187|Moving Pictures]]'' and is located in between [[Ecruteak City]] and [[Olivine City]]. It is most likely called this because [[Sophia]] and [[Marcello]], the two who run the lodge, live here and take their anniversary photograph with hundreds of {{p|Sunflora}} every year. The wooden construction is at least fifty years old. It was visited by {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}}, {{an|Brock}}, and {{Todd}} while they were trying to defrost a {{p|Sunkern}} after an {{p|Articuno}} flew past.
